page_title: MON 1-4 ROM | Monza v AS Roma 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post.
89' AS Roma have a free kick.

87' 1 - 4 Well, this is definitely a candidate for the goal of the year. Andrea Carboni (Monza) receives a precise pass and releases an excellent long-range howitzer of a strike, which finds its way into the net as it flies into the top left corner.
85' Here is a change. Luca Caldirola is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Giulio Donati (Monza).
85' Substitution. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) in, Milan Djuric out.
84' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
82' 0 - 4 Goal! Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Michele Di Gregorio into the top right corner.
82' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is going to take the penalty!
82' The AS Roma players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
81' There's a break in play and referee Marco Piccinini must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by AS Roma using VAR. This could be interesting!
81' One of the AS Roma players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
80' The resulting corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is cleared.

80' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Daniele De Rossi is forced to make a change. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is unable to continue due to injury, Dean Huijsen comes on.
77' Substitution. Paulo Dybala makes way for Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
76' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Monza can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' The resulting set piece from Monza is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monza.

73' Warren Bondo (Monza) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the roof of the net, but is thwarted by a great save from Mile Svilar. Monza earn a corner.
72' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' The foul by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was seen by Marco Piccinini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
70' Andrea Carboni (Monza) latches onto a lofted pass from Daniel Maldini on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
66' Substitution. Daniel Maldini (Monza) on for Dany Mota.
63' 0 - 3 Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up inside the right post.
62' The referee gives a yellow card to Warren Bondo (Monza).
59' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Angelino is replaced by Chris Smalling (AS Roma).
59' That will be all from Lorenzo Pellegrini who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Edoardo Bove (AS Roma).
58' Mile Svilar (AS Roma) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
57' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

57' Milan Djuric (Monza) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Monza will have a corner.
56' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts the ball.
54' A dangerous towering header by Andrea Carboni (Monza) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
54' Dany Mota (Monza) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
53' Dany Mota (Monza) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Monza are awarded a corner kick.
52' Dany Mota (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but Mile Svilar punches the ball away.
50' Milan Djuric (Monza) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
48' Angelino (AS Roma) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
46' Half-time substitution. Andrea Colpani (Monza) will not participate anymore and Georgios Kyriakopoulos is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+7' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
45+7' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
45+2' The Monza players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
42' 0 - 2 Paulo Dybala provides Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
41' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Dany Mota (Monza) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
38' 0 - 1 Goal! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is teed up on the edge of the box by Romelu Lukaku, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
36' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
35' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
34' Marco Piccinini blows for a foul after Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
32' Monza are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Dany Mota (Monza) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
28' Valentin Carboni (Monza) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Piccinini saw the whole situation.
27' Zeki Celik comes onto the pitch because Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
25' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
24' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
22' Here comes a substitution. Roberto Gagliardini is given a rest as he is replaced by Valentin Carboni (Monza).
22' The goal by AS Roma won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
20' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The AS Roma players aren’t happy.
18' Goal! Paulo Dybala slips it to Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) on the edge of the box and he finds the right side of the net with a great effort. The score is 0:1.
18' AS Roma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

18' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.

17' Milan Djuric (Monza) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
13' Dangerous play by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma). Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

9' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.

7' Chance! Angelino sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Bryan Cristante (AS Roma), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
6' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
5' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
4' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is able to continue to play.
2' The game is interrupted now, Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
2' Milan Djuric (Monza) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Marco Piccinini will referee today's match.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
